abstract_sentences.text: Dynamically configuring algorithm hyperparameters is a fundamental challenge in computational intelligence.

evidence.anchor: Dynamically configuring algorithm hyperparameters

abstract_sentences.text: While learning-based methods offer automation, they suffer from prohibitive sample complexity and poor generalization.

evidence.anchor: prohibitive sample complexity and poor generalization

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce AutoEP, a novel framework that bypasses training entirely by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) as zero-shot reasoning engines for algorithm control.

evidence.anchor: bypasses training entirely

abstract_sentences.text: AutoEP’s core innovation lies in a tight synergy between two components: (1) an online Exploratory Landscape Analysis (ELA) module that provides real-time, quantitative feedback on the search dynamics, and (2) a multi-LLM reasoning chain that interprets this feedback to generate adaptive hyperparameter strategies.

evidence.anchor: tight synergy between two components

abstract_sentences.text: This approach grounds high-level reasoning in empirical data, mitigating hallucination.

evidence.anchor: grounds high-level reasoning in empirical data

abstract_sentences.text: Evaluated on three distinct metaheuristics across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks, AutoEP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art tuners, including neural evolution and other LLM-based methods.

evidence.anchor: Evaluated on three distinct metaheuristics

abstract_sentences.text: Notably, our framework enables open-source models like Qwen3-30B to match the performance of GPT-4, demonstrating a powerful and accessible new paradigm for automated hyperparameter design.

evidence.anchor: Qwen3-30B to match the performance of GPT-4

abstract_sentences.text: Our code is available at https://github.com/YiZheZhang12/AutoEP.

evidence.anchor: Our code is available

final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 ELA 五指标及阈值、State-Sensing/Reasoning/Action、Strategist/Analyst/Actuator、TSP 主表、ELA/CoR 消融、窗口消融及模型/频率/动态轨迹图（p3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: CVRP/FSSP/UAV 完整表、全部 prompts、硬件/API/初始参数移入 Appendix B–D（p14–19）；迁移提高正文紧凑度，但四任务主张与复现输入需要跨页查找。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 闭环架构、Figure 3 对话链、Table 2 删除组件对照和 Table 4 质量/延迟并置共同把抽象 LLM 能力变成可审计组件（p5–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有 dedicated limitations、seed/预算/误差/显著性/复杂度；SOTA、consistently、significantly 和 any 的语气超出均值及有限范围可直接支撑的程度，runtime trade-off 需读者自行重建（p7–10、p14–15）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: LLM 控制器应拆成可观测状态、方向诊断、数值动作、反馈记忆四个可单独删除/替换的边界，并用组件消融和质量+延迟决策量共同回收主张（p5–9）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有可计算 trajectory/state 和可重复 action 的在线优化；没有可靠状态指标、可比动作幅度或低成本反馈时，ELA→LLM grounding 与 CoR 消融不能直接迁移；本文未验证连续优化或三种以外算法（p3–4、p7、p14–15）。
